beauty-hair.name: Beauty & hair salons
beauty-hair.title: Booking system for beauty and hair salons
beauty-hair.headline:
Treatments and haircuts in progress.
Bookings kept in order.
beauty-hair.intro: One customer needs two hours for colour; another only wants a haircut. Beauty treatments have different preparation needs too. BookingYou brings services, durations and bookings together. Customers request a suitable time, and you confirm it around the day’s schedule.
beauty-hair.description: How can beauty and hair salons manage bookings with BookingYou? Explore service durations, web bookings without the app, and how merchants review pending requests, notes and rescheduling.
pains: No free hand to answer messages during a service
Put your booking link in your Instagram bio, messages or an in-store QR card. Customers can choose a service and time without waiting for you to list every opening.
Cuts, colour and treatments take different lengths of time
Create separate services with their own durations and prices. This helps prevent a vague request for “hair” from taking an unsuitable time slot.
Separate phone and online records are easy to lose track of
After agreeing a phone or walk-in appointment, add it on the customer’s behalf and check the day’s bookings in the same calendar.
A new customer’s needs are unclear, so you hesitate to accept
Web requests start as pending. Read the notes before confirming and contact the customer if needed to clarify the service and check that the time is suitable.
services: State whether washing and styling are included to avoid surprises on arrival.
Offer a consultation first when hair condition or a quote needs to be assessed.
Allow for welcoming the customer, preparation and cleaning when setting the time you can offer.
customer: Read the service details first
Customers open your link, review haircut, colour consultation or treatment durations and prices, then choose the service they need.
Choose a date and enter booking details
Choose an available slot and enter a name, phone number and optional note. For example, mention a colour consultation so you can understand the request before confirming.
Submit and wait for your confirmation
A web request is not confirmed immediately. Customers keep their personal booking link to check its status or cancel using the options on that page.
merchant: Open “Bookings” in the merchant app
Review new requests in the pending list, checking the service, date, time, customer details and notes without matching everything back to private messages.
Confirm against your actual capacity
Check the day’s confirmed appointments, then assess staff, seats and treatment preparation. Contact the customer first if anything is unclear.
Keep the day’s schedule up to date
View confirmed appointments in the booking list or calendar. Reschedule when a customer needs a different time and mark the booking completed after the service.
faqs: Can it automatically assign a specific stylist or treatment room?

This workflow centres on services, time slots and merchant confirmation. The shop must confirm staff, seats and rooms; an available slot does not mean these resources have been assigned automatically.
How can customers book when colour duration and price are not yet known?

Create a consultation service first, or explain pricing conditions in the service description. Check the customer’s needs before confirming the full service instead of using one duration for every colour appointment.
Do customers have to download the app?
When the merchant enables web booking, customers can submit a request in a browser without downloading the app or registering. Merchants review and confirm bookings in the BookingYou app.

nail-studios.name: Nail studios
nail-studios.title: Booking system for nail studios
nail-studios.headline:
Removal, plain colour or nail art.
Allow the right time for every style.
nail-studios.intro: A customer books plain colour, then arrives needing removal and an intricate design. It is a familiar challenge for nail studios. Make the scope clear when customers choose a service, and review notes before confirming so the schedule reflects the work involved.
nail-studios.description: A booking guide for nail studios: set up removal, plain colour and design services, let customers choose a time through your link, and review notes and durations before confirming in one place.
pains: You do not know whether removal is needed
Offer “plain colour” and “removal + plain colour” separately. Ask customers to describe their current nails in the notes and check the details before confirming.
Intricate designs delay the next customer
Set durations to match each service’s complexity. Discuss designs you cannot yet time with the customer before confirming, rather than using the shortest slot.
Replying to Instagram while painting nails breaks your focus
Put your booking link in your Instagram bio so customers can see services and availability themselves. Review requests between appointments.
Last-minute changes leave records out of sync
Reschedule the same booking so the calendar shows the latest plan. Add phone bookings too, reducing the need for separate records.
services: State whether shaping and basic care are included.
Include removal time in the service so customers can choose more accurately.
For intricate art or extensions, understand the request before arranging the full service.
customer: Choose a service with or without removal
Open the studio’s link, read the descriptions and durations, then choose plain colour, a service including removal, or a design consultation.
Add your preferences and contact details
Choose an available date and time, enter a name and phone number, and note whether there is existing gel and what kind of design is wanted.
Keep your booking link
Wait for the studio to confirm after submitting. If a design photo is needed, send it separately using the studio’s contact method, then check the booking status.
merchant: Review pending requests together
In the merchant booking list, review the selected service, time and notes to identify removal or design requirements first.
Check the time needed before accepting
Contact the customer when more detail is needed, then check the service and availability before confirming. Set aside time for cleaning tools and breaks too.
Use the calendar for appointments and changes
Check the appointments before and after each booking in the calendar. Reschedule if needed and mark the service completed afterwards.
faqs: Can customers choose several add-ons at once?
This workflow shows a customer choosing one service. Create common combinations such as “removal + plain colour” as separate services; do not assume add-on durations are added automatically.
Can customers upload design photos in the web booking form?
This web workflow currently uses a name, phone number and text notes. Send design photos separately through the studio’s chosen contact method and agree the design before arranging the time.
Does BookingYou collect deposits?
The booking workflow described here does not include collecting payments. The studio and customer arrange payments or deposits separately and should make the terms clear in the service description.

personal-training.name: Personal trainers
personal-training.title: Booking system for personal trainers and fitness studios
personal-training.headline:
Keep sessions clearly scheduled.
Focus on coaching each one well.
personal-training.intro: Trials, regular training and small-group sessions need different capacities and arrangements. Working across locations also takes travel time. BookingYou lets clients submit their own requests, then you check the day’s timetable and confirm, leaving more room to discuss their training.
personal-training.description: How can personal trainers manage trials and training bookings? Learn how clients choose slots, how coaches review pending and confirmed sessions, and how to set capacity and allow travel time.
pains: Every client asks whether tonight is available
Share your booking link so clients can view the hours you have opened before submitting a request, reducing repeated lists of available times.
One-to-one and group sessions have different capacities
Create separate services for session types and set capacity to match what you can deliver. Check venue and class arrangements before accepting group requests too.
One session ends and you must rush to the next venue
Block travel, preparation and rest time. Only offer hours you can realistically reach and teach.
Clients remember the old time after rescheduling
Reschedule within the same booking and check the latest session in the calendar. Web customers can revisit their personal link to check the status.
services: State the location, who it is suitable for and what to bring.
Open bookings around the coach’s actual teaching availability.
Set capacity to match what you can deliver. A slot’s capacity does not automatically assign a venue.
customer: Choose a trial or training session
Clients open the link, check service and location details, duration and price, then choose the session they need.
Request a time you can attend
Choose a date and available slot, then enter a name and phone number. Notes can mention a first visit or general training goals to help the coach prepare.
Wait for confirmation before finalising plans
Web bookings require the coach’s confirmation. Keep the booking link to check its status. Contact the coach first if the time needs to change.
merchant: View new sessions in the merchant app
Open the pending tab in the booking list and check the client, session type, time and notes.
Check venue and timing before confirming
Compare the request with confirmed sessions in the calendar and allow for travel and rest. Check numbers and the actual venue for group sessions too.
Update status before and after training
Use the confirmed list to welcome clients. Reschedule by changing the booking time, then mark the session completed so you can refer to it later.
faqs: Can it automatically schedule weekly sessions in one go?

This page describes choosing a time for each booking, not automatically creating a recurring timetable. Coaches can arrange regular clients one session at a time on agreed dates and check each booking.
Will it automatically deduct sessions from a package?
A completed booking status only means the session is finished. This page does not promise package deductions or membership billing. Handle course and payment records through your existing process.
Can clients book a group session directly?
Set capacity and available slots for the service; the exact workflow depends on the merchant’s settings. The coach still needs to confirm the venue, equipment and teaching arrangements.

tutoring-classes.name: Tutoring & teaching
tutoring-classes.title: Booking system for tutors and teaching studios
tutoring-classes.headline:
Trials, regular lessons and make-ups.
Every lesson clearly arranged.
tutoring-classes.intro: Parents book trials for their children, students change make-up lesson times, and teachers need room to prepare. BookingYou brings each lesson request and its status together, so you can check the subject, level and time before confirming.
tutoring-classes.description: A booking guide for tutors and teaching studios: how parents or students choose trials, submit details and wait for confirmation, and how teachers review notes, manage make-up lessons and set class capacity.
pains: Parents ask about subjects, then exchange more messages about times
Create services by subject or course type with clear levels and durations, so parents choose the right lesson before selecting a time.
Too little trial information makes preparation difficult
Ask parents to note the student’s year level or what they want to explore. Review this before confirming and contact them if more detail is needed.
Make-up lesson messages are scattered across conversations
Reschedule within the same booking and add make-up sessions agreed by phone, keeping students and dates easy to check together.
Class places and preparation time get used up together
Set each session’s capacity to reflect the number you can teach, and reserve preparation, breaks and classroom reset time.
services: State the suitable year level, subject and trial format.
Distinguish subjects or courses so parents choose the right service.
State the level and capacity, and confirm the actual classroom and teaching arrangements.
customer: Parents or students choose a lesson
Open the teacher’s or studio’s link, choose a service by subject, level or trial type, then view available dates.
Enter the contact person’s details
Enter a name and contact number. Parents booking for a child can add the student’s name, year level and general learning needs in the notes, without unrelated personal information.
Keep the link to check confirmation
Wait for the teacher to confirm after submitting. Keep the booking link and coordinate with the teacher first if a make-up lesson or time change is needed.
merchant: Review pending lessons and notes
The merchant booking list shows the service, time, contact person and notes. First distinguish trials, regular lessons and other session types.
Check level and teaching arrangements
Check the subject, student’s level, class capacity and classroom availability. Contact the parent for any missing details before confirming the request.
Follow lessons and make-ups in the calendar
Review confirmed lessons each day. Check the new date after rescheduling, then mark taught lessons completed for later reference.
faqs: Can parents book for their children?
A parent can submit a web request as the contact person and add the student’s name or year level in the notes. The teacher checks the actual lesson arrangements when confirming.
Can this replace a full student management system?
This page covers lesson bookings and scheduling, not grades, homework, attendance reporting or tuition fee management. Handle those records separately through your teaching process.
Will a full term’s timetable be generated automatically?
This workflow is based on individual bookings. Create and confirm regular lessons on agreed dates one at a time; one request does not automatically schedule the entire term.

pet-grooming.name: Pet grooming
pet-grooming.title: Booking system for pet grooming salons
pet-grooming.headline:
Every pet has different needs.
Check the details before booking grooming.
pet-grooming.intro: Bathing and trimming time depends on size, coat and the pet’s condition. Let owners select a service and leave basic notes, then have the groomer check the time and reception arrangements instead of fitting every pet into the same slot.
pet-grooming.description: A pet grooming booking guide: how owners choose bathing or trimming and add notes, and how merchants review requests, check size and coat, arrange drop-off and collection, and confirm services.
pains: “Bath” tells you nothing about size or coat until arrival
State who each service is suitable for. Ask owners to note the pet’s type, size and requested service, then check the details before confirming.
Every pet needs a different amount of time
Set different durations for different service scopes. Contact the owner first when assessment is needed rather than estimating from the shortest slot.
The dryer drowns out calls, but you do not want to miss bookings
Offer a link and QR code so owners can submit a request themselves. Groomers can review pending requests together during a suitable break.
Grooming time gets confused with collection time
Agree drop-off and collection details when confirming. Allow cleaning, preparation and handover time rather than treating a booking’s start time as a collection promise.
services: State the size range and included services. The shop confirms the final arrangements.
Confirm the time needed based on coat, style and actual requirements.
When duration cannot be estimated ahead of time, discuss the needs before arranging the full service.
customer: The owner chooses a suitable service
Open the shop’s link and check suitability, details, duration and price before choosing bathing, trimming or a consultation.
Enter the owner’s contact details and pet notes
Choose a slot and enter a name and phone number. Notes can include the pet’s name, type, size and service needs to help the shop follow up.
Wait for the shop to confirm the arrangements
Keep the personal booking link to check its status. Follow the shop’s confirmed instructions for drop-off, collection and anything to prepare.
merchant: Open the booking list to review new requests
In the pending tab, check the owner’s contact details, service, time and notes to understand the preparation needed.
Check the pet’s needs and the day’s capacity
Contact the owner if anything is unclear. Confirm service time, capacity and handover arrangements before approving the booking.
Work from the day’s confirmed records
Check today’s appointments in the calendar or confirmed list. Reschedule changes and mark the booking completed after the service.
faqs: Does the system estimate grooming time by breed automatically?
In this workflow, merchants set service durations. Time is not estimated automatically from breed, coat or matting. Speak with the owner before confirming whenever you need more detail.
How many pets can be included in one booking?
Do not treat a general party-size field as a pet count. For several pets, contact the shop first so the merchant can confirm services, time slots and whether separate bookings are needed.
Is this a veterinary appointment system?
This page describes pet bathing and grooming schedules. It does not provide diagnosis, medical records or medical triage. Contact a qualified veterinarian directly about pet health concerns.
